name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet

Male, early 20s, slender wiry build not yet filled out by years of campaigning, fair olive skin with a faint sunburn across the nose, high cheekbones suggesting Albanian or Bulgarian devşirme origin, a thin youthful mustache with clean-shaven chin, cropped dark hair hidden beneath a white felt börk folded low over the neck with a small brass kaşıklık holder and a short undyed plume. Wearing a crimson wool kaftan cinched at the waist with a blue silk sash, loose şalvar trousers tucked into soft leather boots. A recurve composite bow of horn and sinew is held diagonally across the body, a cylindrical leather quiver bristling with fletched arrows slung across his back, a slim yatağan tucked through the sash at his hip. Calloused fingertips and a leather thumb-ring visible on the draw hand. Expression calm, focused, the quiet confidence of a marksman rather than a brawler. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
